title: Out-of-network ATM fees for Evergreen Account
summary: This document explains Evergreen Account out-of-network ATM fees from Rho: a separate fee per withdrawal when using an ATM not in Rho’s network. The fee is 1% of the cash dispensed amount, capped at $2.50 per withdrawal, and shown as a separate line item on transaction history (excluding any ATM operator surcharge).
faqs: When do I get charged an out-of-network ATM fee for my Evergreen Account?
How is the out-of-network ATM fee calculated (1% of what) and what is the $2.50 cap?
Is the $2.50 cap applied to the ATM operator’s surcharge too?
How does the fee appear on my transaction history and is it deducted in addition to cash?
If I make multiple withdrawals in one day, do I pay the fee more than once?
What are the recommended ways to avoid or reduce out-of-network ATM fees?

Fee deducted in addition to cash withdrawn
